name: Sawada Eimi
source:
A nurse at Toriume Hospital whose devoted, caring manner has made her popular with patients; she has a hard time refusing people who ask her for things, so her work hours have increased and she spends less time with her husband, whom she married not long ago. It’s a constant worry for her.

She's a loving, doting wife who protects both her husband and her patients with overflowing maternal instinct, and is happy to let them take the lead. Her large breasts are a source of frustration for her, as they block her view and lead to frequent mishaps at work.
